Ada Lovelace developed ideas about the possibilities of computation through her work with Charles Babbage.[1]

Her notes connect mathematical methods with an imaginative view of what a machine could represent.

Biography

edit

Education

Private study and correspondence encouraged her interest in scientific questions.

Work

Translation and extended commentary became an important part of her mathematical writing.
